import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/words.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/words.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
print('characters',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout[:33000])
